name: jc-code
description: Code-related skills vetted by John. Skills: drawio (generate .drawio diagrams and export PNG/SVG/PDF via the draw.io desktop CLI); mermaid (author and repair Mermaid diagrams, validated by rendering with mermaid-cli); guided-review (guide human judgments of an existing Review JSON with an overview table and detailed Finding cards); claude-setup (install John's preferred Claude Code machine setup, currently the status line script and its settings.json wiring); interactive-design (walk a fuzzy small-to-medium build request through interview, vocabulary, and consequences to a short written design saved in the repo); implement (coordinate an approved tech spec through build, review, and understanding); implement-build (build the approved spec and check the result); implement-review (generate and challenge findings in fresh contexts, then resolve them); implement-understand (explain implementation decisions and tradeoffs beyond the spec).
